# dsh-ntfy

中文 · Push one notification when a DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
turn **actually stops** — so you can leave

the desk and still know when the agent is done, waiting for
approval, or asking you a question.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Features
- **Only on a real stop.** After `turn/end` it waits `settleMs` (2 s); a new turn — goal continuatio

n,
queued message, steering — cancels the pending push.
- **Quiet by design.** Root sessions only, e

nd-reason allowlist, minimum duration, 10-minute dedupe,
bounded queue. Short rounds never ring.
- *
*Speaks up when DSH is stuck.** Approval requests and questions are pushed immediately, with their o

wn
priority.
- **GUI settings.** Settings → **ntfy Notify** covers all 22 options, applies live, and

can send a test.
- **Self-hosted, plain text.** Token is read from a `0600` file, secrets are redac

st.
- **Self-hosted, plain text.** Token is read from a `0600` file, secrets are redacted, no emoji.
## Requirements

- DSH **≥ 0.2.1-rc.2**, `web` profile (the settings page is a client half).
- Node.js **≥ 20**.
- A

reachable ntfy server. With auth enabled (`auth-default-access: deny-all`)
you need an access token.
## Install
From the DSH GUI: **Settings → Plugins → add a third-party plugin**, spec:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or ask the agent to call `plugin_manager` `install_bundle` with the same spec. The manager installs

the
package and enables the bundle in one step.
Then **restart `dsh web` once** so the host module is loaded. Later config changes apply live.
If your ntfy server requires auth, open **Settings → ntfy Notify** and paste the token: it is writte

n
to a `0600` file and only the file path is kept in the profile.
Manual CLI install:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Uninstall: remove the bundle in the plugin manager, or disable the `ntfy` row in the profile patch.
The token file is left behind on purpose; delete it yourself if you no longer need it.
